name: Oriole Park at Camden Yards

note: The OSM stadium leisure boundary owns the bowl and field; mapped warehouse93170801 and two small stadium pavilions are also declared. The stadium is an open horseshoe with stepped seats, exposed upper steelwork and true negative space above the brick street facade. The Ravens’ published stadium facts imply an Oriole Park height of 150 ft (45.72 m) by stating that their 185 ft stadium stands 35 ft above it. This model’s 42 m maximum is a photo-based estimate with a different unverified roof/lighting datum; the discrepancy is unresolved and should be checked during independent review.
